q.text:
Read the situations and write your answer.
One of your friends, Stella, invites you to a birthday party at the weekend. Refuse the invitation and
make an excuse.
a. ....................................................................................................................................................
Your friends are organizing a picnic on Sunday and want you to join. Accept the invitation and ask for a
detail about the event.
b. ....................................................................................................................................................
q.sol_text:
a. I’m sorry, but I can’t come to your birthday party because I have to visit my grandparents.
b. Sure, I’d love to join you. What time does the picnic start?

q.text:
Read the text and answer the questions.
Hi, everybody! I’m Morgan. I’m an 8th-grade student and I love spending time with my friends. On
weekdays, I get up at 7 a.m. and have breakfast with my parents. My school isn’t close to my house, so
I take the school bus. My classes start at 8:30 a.m. and finish at 3 p.m. After school, I play basketball
with my friends on Mondays and Wednesdays. On Fridays, I go to a music club and play the guitar. At
weekends, I enjoy riding my bike and meeting my friends. In the evenings, I usually do my homework,
listen to music, and surf the Internet. I go to bed at 10:30 p.m.
a. Why does Morgan go to school by bus?
....................................................................................................................................
b. What time do his classes finish?
....................................................................................................................................
İNGİLİZCE
c. When does Morgan play basketball?
....................................................................................................................................
d. What does Morgan do at weekends?
....................................................................................................................................
e. Does Morgan go to any clubs on weekdays?
....................................................................................................................................
q.sol_text:
a. Because his school isn’t close to his house.
b. His classes finish at 3 p.m.
c. He plays basketball after school on Mondays and Wednesdays.
d. At weekends, he enjoys riding his bike and meeting his friends.
e. Yes, he does. He goes to a music club on Fridays.

q.text:
Read Mark’s invitation and fill in the blanks.
Dear Fabian,
Our class is organizing a movie night on Friday, November 12 th . It starts at 7:00 p.m. at
my house. We will watch movies, chat, eat pizza, and play board games together. It’s
going to be a lot of fun! I hope you can make it.
Please inform me if you can attend.
Love,
Mark
a. Sender : ......................................................
b. Receiver : ......................................................
c. Event : ......................................................
d. Place : ......................................................
e. Date : ......................................................
q.sol_text:
a. Sender : Mark
b. Receiver : Fabian
c. Event : A movie night
d. Place : Mark’s house
e. Date : Friday, November 12th

q.text:
Read the text and write True (T) or False (F) for the statements below.
Alex is a 14-year-old student. He is an energetic boy and gets on well with his friends. On weekdays, he
always finishes his homework first and then he surfs the Internet. He is crazy about listening to music.
His favorite type of music is rock because he finds it energetic and awesome.
He rarely reads detective books and he hates watching soap operas. He thinks they are ridiculous
and boring. Alex prefers wearing sports clothes and sneakers because he finds them stylish and
comfortable. On Sundays, he loves cycling in the park with his close friends. They rarely argue, and
they usually support one another.
a. ( ..... ) Alex has a good relationship with his friends.
b. ( ..... ) He loves rock music because he thinks it is energetic and awesome.
c. ( ..... ) He listens to music before doing his homework on weekdays.
d. ( ..... ) He enjoys watching soap operas in his free time.
e. ( ..... ) Alex prefers sports clothes because he finds them comfortable and stylish.
f. ( ..... ) He goes cycling alone in the park on Sundays.
q.sol_text:
a. True (T)
b. True (T)
c. False (F)
d. False (F)
e. True (T)
f. False (F)
